text: {"name":"ll_conn_event_dispatch","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Validates a BLE connection-event slot and its associated station context, configures radio and channel settings, and delegates rejected events to the event preparer.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v2":"conn_slot","v5":"sta_idx","v7":"sta_ctx","v9":"conn_flags_initial","v13":"conn_flags","v14":"conn_slot_ctx"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":28,"meaning":"Connection-event slot selector, validated against the four supported slots."},{"offset":29,"meaning":"Station-table index; 0xFF is a sentinel indicating no station index."},{"offset":30,"meaning":"Connection/event flags, including bits tested at 0x08, 0x10, and 0x80."},{"offset":44,"meaning":"Pointer to the selected event or radio configuration."},{"offset":72,"meaning":"Pointer to a nested radio/channel configuration context."}]}
